project.name: Gas Turbine Substation for Tier 4 Hyperscale Datacenter
project.description: On-site 120MW dual-fuel simple-cycle combustion turbine and 230kV substation to provide continuous primary and mission-critical backup power for datacenter facility.

documents.title: Air Quality Operating Permit & SCR Compliance SOP
documents.raw_text:
### Section 1. Nitrogen Oxides (NOx) Control
The 120MW simple-cycle gas turbine incorporates selective catalytic reduction (SCR) with aqueous ammonia injection. Steady-state NOx emissions shall not exceed 2.5 ppmvd at 15 percent O2.

### Section 2. Emissions Monitoring and Reporting
The facility operates a continuous emission monitoring system (CEMS) calibrated per 40 CFR Part 60 Appendix B. Quarterly compliance summaries must be submitted within 30 days of quarter close.

obligations.description: Maintain steady-state simple-cycle gas turbine NOx emissions at or below 2.5 ppmvd at 15% O2 using SCR systems.
Conduct continuous NOx monitoring via CEMS and submit certified compliance reports within 30 days of each quarter end.
